project.title: Launch of a Mixed-Use Property Leasing & Management Program
project.objective: Prepare and launch a coordinated leasing and property management program for a new mixed-use building, ensuring fast occupancy, compliant operations, and sustainable revenue.
deliverables: Leasing and pricing strategy for residential and commercial units
Standardised lease agreement templates and addenda
Operational playbook for on-site property management
Health, safety, and maintenance procedures for the building
Marketing and tenant acquisition plan outline
constraints: Go-live for first tenants within 30 days
All contracts must comply with local tenancy and commercial lease regulations
Budget for pre-launch activities is capped and must be tracked monthly
Health and safety procedures must meet building and fire codes
Marketing must align with corporate brand guidelines
Any construction-related changes must not delay occupancy date

risks.risk: Delayed completion of minor construction and snagging could push back tenant move-in dates.
risks.mitigation: Coordinate weekly with construction, maintain snagging list, prioritise critical areas for occupancy sign-off.

risks.risk: Lease terms may not be competitive, leading to slow uptake of units.
risks.mitigation: Benchmark local market, allow limited promotional discounts, review pricing after first 10 signed leases.

risks.risk: Operational issues (maintenance, safety) at launch could trigger complaints or regulatory issues.
risks.mitigation: Implement pre-launch safety audit, create incident response checklist, train staff on procedures.

risks.risk: Cash flow projections may be inaccurate due to uncertain initial occupancy.
risks.mitigation: Model conservative, base, and optimistic scenarios; review actuals monthly and adjust spend accordingly.

risks.risk: Misalignment between owner expectations and proposed leasing strategy.
risks.mitigation: Present strategy options early, document decisions, obtain written approval on pricing bands and tenant mix.

themes.why_relevant: Core to achieving target occupancy and revenue while staying competitive in the local market.
Reduces legal risk and speeds up deal closure across residential and commercial leases.
Ensures building, safety, and services are ready for tenants on day one.
Aligns owner expectations with realistic cash flow and profitability scenarios.
Construction, owners, and facility providers must stay aligned to hit the launch date.
Good onboarding and service reduce churn and support long-term asset value.

backlog.task: Define target tenant mix and initial pricing bands for all unit types
definition_of_done: Tenant mix matrix completed for residential and commercial units
Pricing bands validated against at least three comparable properties
Owner sign-off recorded in project documentation

backlog.task: Draft standard residential and commercial lease templates with addenda
definition_of_done: Residential and commercial templates created with key clauses
Compliance review completed by legal or policy reference
Version control and storage location shared with team

backlog.task: Create a unit inventory and availability tracker for leasing
definition_of_done: All units listed with size, type, floor, and status
Tracker includes fields for price, tenant lead, and expected move-in
Shared with team and updated baseline published

backlog.task: Prepare a 12‑month financial forecast for rental income and costs
definition_of_done: Assumptions on occupancy and pricing documented
Income, operating costs, and net cash flow projected monthly
Scenario analysis (base, conservative, optimistic) completed

backlog.task: Coordinate final construction snagging list impacting leasing
definition_of_done: Snagging items collected from construction and site visits
Items prioritised by impact on occupancy and safety
Agreed completion dates documented and shared

backlog.task: Design tenant onboarding process and welcome pack
definition_of_done: Checklist for move-in day created
Welcome information (contacts, rules, services) drafted
Process reviewed and approved by real estate manager

backlog.task: Define building health, safety, and emergency procedures
definition_of_done: Key procedures documented (fire, evacuation, incidents)
Roles and responsibilities assigned for on-site staff
Procedures aligned with regulatory requirements

backlog.task: Set up rent collection and arrears monitoring process
definition_of_done: Payment methods and due dates defined
Arrears escalation steps documented
Reporting format for overdue accounts agreed

backlog.task: Outline marketing and lead generation activities for launch
definition_of_done: List of marketing channels and activities drafted
Key messages and positioning defined
Owner approval obtained for initial marketing plan

backlog.task: Create monthly performance dashboard structure for the property
definition_of_done: KPIs defined (occupancy, rent collection, arrears, complaints)
Dashboard layout drafted in a sheet or template
Update cadence and data sources agreed

backlog.task: Develop service level expectations with facility management provider
definition_of_done: Scope of services and response times documented
Basic KPIs for cleaning, maintenance, and repairs defined
Agreement shared with facility management provider

backlog.task: Prepare owner update pack for pre-launch and first quarter
definition_of_done: Standard slide or document template created
Sections for leasing status, financials, and risks included
Schedule for regular owner updates agreed

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on tenant mix, pricing strategy, and owner expectations for launch.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing project scope and need to lock pricing within the week.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve target tenant mix for residential vs commercial units.
Confirm initial pricing bands and any promotional discounts for first leases.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalise lease templates and operational processes for leasing and rent collection.
threads_plan.trigger: Update that first draft of lease templates is ready for review and comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve standard residential and commercial lease templates for use.
Agree on rent collection methods, due dates, and arrears escalation steps.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Ensure building readiness, safety compliance, and coordination with construction.
threads_plan.trigger: Report from site visit highlighting remaining snagging and safety items.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Prioritise which snagging items must be fixed before first move-ins.
Approve final health and safety procedures for building operations.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock tenant onboarding flow, marketing actions, and lead handling process.
threads_plan.trigger: Real estate agent shares draft onboarding checklist and marketing outline.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve tenant onboarding process and welcome pack contents.
Select primary marketing channels and lead qualification rules for launch.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on reporting cadence, KPIs, and owner communication format post-launch.
threads_plan.trigger: Proposal to standardise monthly dashboard and owner update pack.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm KPI set and structure of the monthly performance dashboard.
Agree on frequency and format of owner update reports in first quarter.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in on leasing progress and blockers
Twice-weekly site readiness update with snagging status
Weekly review of leads, signed leases, and pricing feedback
Bi-weekly risk and decision log update before owner touchpoint
